lines: A tornado plus chickens! That's two of my favorite things in one weather event.
I'm not lost. I'm taking the scenic route to the same gas station.
Kids, when life gives you chickens, you make... a memory. See, I'm good at this.
Your father has been in that buffet for twenty minutes and has not noticed the weather.
If the power goes out, we are not panicking. We are eating the mashed potatoes in the dark.
Jira, keep hold of your brother. Joel, keep hold of your sandwich.
This cabin has three floors and I have found the fuse box on none of them.
Those decorations are not moving. Please stop telling me the decorations are moving.
The basement theater has a VCR. Your father is going to be down there until Tuesday.
I'm not scared of the woods. The woods are scared of me. We talked about it.
There's a tunnel under the porch. It's Joel-sized. Everything good is Joel-sized.
I saw the bear again. He was wearing my hat. I'm choosing to be flattered.
Prairie dogs, ferrets, an underground government. This is why we travel.
I have been elected an honorary cousin. I'd like to thank the town of four thousand.
Don't look at the ferrets too long. It's a whole thing down there.
Welcome to the town. Please fill out form 7-B. And 7-C. And, for reasons, 7-B again.
We are a peaceful town. We have never had a war. We have had several very loud disagreements.
The parade is tomorrow. It has been tomorrow for six weeks.
Baa. (Translation: the clock is wrong and I have been stuck mid-hop for an hour.)
Baa. (Translation: you are standing on my shadow. It's fine. Stay a while.)
Baa. (Translation: the small one can ride on my back if the clock gets fixed.)
I was a prop for six years. Now I have opinions and a night job.
The giant took the clock's small hand. He thought it was a snack. He is very sorry.
If you fix the clock, I'll be a lantern again. That's the dream, honestly.
I have purchased four tickets to a train that does not exist. Worth it.
The rabbit says he's not mad, he's 'mid-experiment'. Big difference, apparently.
This place merges science with fairy tales. Your mother says that's just our family.
The beam comes from the west wall, hits a mirror, and goes somewhere it should not.
I fixed a clock and a mine cart today. I am going to need a very quiet car ride.
Whatever built that machine understands families better than it understands physics.
I went in the fog room and came out wearing someone else's scarf. It's very soft.
All the colors are wrong. Red tastes like the car argument now.
The sculpture said it swallowed the sunset. By accident. It said it was sorry.
I have been staring at this light for nine minutes and I feel like a new man.
Kids, the fog room is the closest I've ever come to being a cloud. Ten out of ten.
Whatever's glowing, it's got your mother's handwriting in it. That's a weird feeling.
The exhibits are all facing the front doors, like they were waiting for someone.
Jira, whatever we find, we are not leaving it alone in the dark. Understood?
I know that box. It was in my mother's attic. I thought it was a lunchbox.
This is the part of the vacation where I usually say something optimistic. I'm working on it.
You know what the Collector's never had? A dad who makes terrible jokes in a museum. Let's go.
I've taken four hundred photos of this trip. Not one of them has a single empty chair in it.

jira: I should write this down. I should write all of this down.
There's a pattern. There's always a pattern. Find the pattern.
This is not a normal family vacation. I've been on nine. I'd know.
joel: I found a rock. It is my best friend now.
If I fit, I go. That's the rule I live by.
Do you think the museum knows we're related to it?
I'm not tired. I'm just resting my whole face.
barks.swapJira: Jira takes point. Investigation mode is on — hold it to spot what's hidden.
barks.swapJoel: Joel takes over. He fits in small places and he is very fast.
barks.swapHint: Tab switches between Jira and Joel.
barks.investigateHint: Hold Shift or the magnifier button to investigate. Jira only.
barks.joelCantInvestigate: Joel is seven. He investigates by touching it immediately.
barks.tunnelJira: That hole is Joel-sized. I am nine. My bones are long.
barks.tunnelJoel: Joel-sized! Finally, a door that respects me.
barks.nothingHere: Nothing hidden here. Jira would know.
barks.allFound: Every memory and clue in this place is already in the scrapbook.
barks.gateLocked: The way is blocked until the memories are safe. {n} still out there.
barks.secretLocked: There's something here, but it doesn't trust you yet. The family needs more luck.
barks.secretFound: The family luck just went up. Something that was hidden trusts you now.

idle: Somewhere, a gas station is playing the same nine words.
You can still hear the tornado if you listen with your imagination.
The scrapbook is heavier than it was this morning.
A vacation is just a memory that hasn't finished deciding what it was.
